identity.label: a3_ema
identity.scope: Native static ROI diagnostics; training-domain reevaluation is not unseen-scene or unseen-sensor generalization. Opposite parity prevents direct target averaging of evaluated input frames, but masks, reference selection and brightness estimation may still depend on the full sequence.

metric_protocol: Native DN error against opposite-parity means; PSNR peak=4095; HP uses 3x3 box highpass and eroded valid support; gradients require both pixels valid; temporal stride is two original frames; flat residual sigma is a noise/detail diagnostic, not standalone quality proof.
